events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/subsys/modem/modem_ubx/src/main.c` where `test_thread_yield()` called `k_yield()` instead of `k_sleep(K_MSEC(1))`. Because `modem_backend_mock` and `modem_ubx` chain multiple work items on the system workqueue (which yields between pending work items) and `script_runner` runs on a cooperative thread at the same priority, a single `k_yield()` returned to the test thread before the work items and script runner thread completed processing.
